traits.name: exact
traits.reason: Prices carry units (wood) and counts are precise, but lots are cited by count, not by letter and number, and no deeds are ticked.

traits.name: fair
traits.reason: The same 5 wood registration fee and 6 wood lot price are posted publicly and repeated unchanged, with no private pricing.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: The identical offer is repeated five times, which looks like chasing buyers, while no one is named or pestered individually.

traits.name: acquisitive
traits.reason: The line pushes wood into the vault, but there is no vault count and no taking of surplus; actions are only eat and move.

traits.name: dry
traits.reason: The aside 'Dirt is cheap until someone surveys it' is about land and not people; most other lines have no aside.

traits.name: methodical
traits.reason: The staking and sales offer are structured, but actions are just looping eat and move with no surveying, registering or brokering progress.
